description.p: LibreCrate is a secure document vault that stores, views, organizes, and searches PDFs, EPUBs, comic archives (CBZ), images, and personal Markdown notes — all encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM.

ul.li: Optional password protection with Argon2id key derivation
PDF viewer with pinch-to-zoom and horizontal/vertical pan
Cross-platform vault format (compatible with Android app)

screenshot.caption: Document library with search and filtering

description.p: Code quality: fixed all clippy/compiler warnings across the workspace. License changed to AGPL-3.0-only.

Backup import now merges: importing a backup into an existing library keeps your documents and adds the backup's content on top, your local passkey stays unchanged, and backups created with a different passkey can be merged (files are re-encrypted with the local key). Phone and desktop share a single Rust backup/import implementation, and phone backups record their key-derivation parameters — fixing phone → desktop import ("crypto error: key unwrap failed"). Also fixed a F-Droid build failure by making MuPDF system-font support an opt-in desktop-only feature.
Privacy: removed unused permissions (WAKE_LOCK, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED, FOREGROUND_SERVICE) and the unused WorkManager dependency — the app now requests no special permissions.
Reproducible builds: Android native library now builds byte-identically for F-Droid, embedded build paths removed, deterministic MuPDF wrapper layout, and OpenSSL ranlib fix.
F-Droid compliance: dropped CBR support and non-free junrar dependency, removed GitHub Packages publishing, desktop dead-code cleanup.
Desktop GUI, interactive CLI, cross-platform backup, and branding.
